description.en: Through ICHA, CHAMPS brought hospital leaders, researchers, and practitioners together to exchange evidence and approaches to hospital governance.
description.id: Melalui ICHA, CHAMPS mempertemukan pemimpin rumah sakit, peneliti, dan praktisi untuk bertukar bukti serta pendekatan tata kelola rumah sakit.
